description: Engine status evaluator rules (card M2-01, P Part 4 Step 2.2, DECISIONS D4). Limits themselves live in configs/engines/<id>.json 'limits'; this file holds only the evaluator's rule constants and the channel -> subsystem map.

exit_margin_fraction_of_band.ref: P Step 2.2 hysteresis: exit only after the value is back inside the band by 2 % of the band span

exit_hold_s.ref: P Step 2.2 hysteresis: ... for 10 s (simulated seconds, D8)

hypothesis_posterior_min.ref: P Step 2.2: a hypothesis with posterior >= 0.7 sets that fault's status_at_full_severity

subsystems.ref: channel -> subsystem, for 'two quarantined sensors on the same subsystem -> CAUTION' (P Step 2.2)
